items.title: The iPhone Duo enters China’s crowded foldable market — and faces a price test
items.summary: Chinese netizens focused on the price of Apple’s iPhone Duo, as cheaper Xiaomi and Huawei foldables raise value comparisons and muddle the foldable's reception.

items.title: California enacts new curbs on social media for children
items.summary: California enacted laws restricting addictive social media features for under-16s and banning AI companion chatbots in toys.

items.title: OpenAI Is Open to Slowing Cutting-Edge AI, Altman Tells Staff
items.summary: OpenAI is considering slowing down the development of cutting-edge artificial intelligence, with CEO Sam Altman hoping other AI companies will do the same. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.summary: Speaking to Fox News presenter Laura Ingraham, Trump said that he would have attacked Iran despite the impact on the midterm elections.

items.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan says 'do nothing' about distillation as AI giants accuse China of copying their tech
items.summary: At Y Combinator’s annual Demo Day, CEO Garry Tan explained why he's less concerned about frontier AI model distillation and the existential risk of AI.

items.title: Chinese AI labs secretly used millions of Claude exchanges to train their models, Anthropic says
